summary: Explains how IETF protocols should use Ethernet frame formats and IEEE 802 parameters, and sets IANA rules for handing out values under the IANA Organizationally Unique Identifier (OUI). It also provides values meant for use in documentation. It replaces RFC 7042, and is a Best Current Practice.

eli5.summary: Every network card has a name tag from a maker. This document says how the IETF borrows those tag rules, who hands out new ones, and which pretend tags are safe to use in examples.
